verdict.rationale: GrowthBook documents official language-specific SDKs: 24 SDKs per GitHub, with dedicated React, Kotlin/Android, and Swift/Apple docs, a few-lines quickstart, edge and script-tag options, and OpenFeature provider support. Community users independently report getting flags running in about 15 minutes and in a Vue frontend within hours; an older thread saying mobile SDKs were missing is superseded by the current Kotlin and Swift SDK docs. Missing for 10: evidence of AI-oriented SDK tooling (e.g. typed codegen or SDK reference surfaced for agents) and depth on SDKs beyond the few highlighted ones.
